title: SC02-T1 — the divorce (SH01, SH02, SH03a, SH03b, SH04, SH05, SH06)
line: I am sorry, Michelle. After thirty one years. / I just... I need something different. / Thirty one years.
motionPlan: Peter, in his coat, stands by the coffee table and sets a plain manila envelope (a little larger than a sheet of paper) on it; Michelle sits in the armchair, very still → the plain manila envelope (a little larger than a sheet of paper) lies on the coffee table; Peter's fingers slide off it → Peter says it to the floor, never meeting her eyes, then half turns toward the archway → Peter says it to the floor, never meeting her eyes, then half turns toward the archway → Michelle, very still in the armchair, eyes on the envelope, whispers it barely aloud → over Michelle's shoulder, Peter walks away through the archway and out of sight; the front door closes beyond → Michelle alone in the armchair as the light dies, the envelope on the table in front of her
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
